steps.error_feedback:
Available resources (11):

insights:shaded-views — Shaded Views
  Rendering Part Studio images via the API, critical `pixelSize` parameter

insights:sketch — Sketch
  Sketch entities, geometry types, constraints, planes, tool decompositions

insights:extrude — Extrude
  Extrude feature parameters, sketch-to-solid workflow, region discovery

insights:revolve — Revolve
  Revolve feature parameters, sketch-to-revolved-solid workflow, axis edge discovery

insights:sweep — Sweep
  Sweep feature parameters, path + profile workflow, perpendicular plane requirement

insights:cplane — Construction Plane
  cPlane creation modes, CURVE_POINT for sweep profiles, visual extent sizing

insights:fillet — Fillet
  Fillet feature parameters, edge discovery, radius constraints

insights:part-studio — Part Studio
  Feature error retrieval via evalFeatureScript, runtime debugging

insights:featurescript — FeatureScript
  Feature Studio API, stdlib version discovery, import conventions, notices workaround

insights:debug-entities — Debug Entities
  Accessing debug entity data via evalFeatureScript, wire body debug geometry for screenshots

insights:workflow — Workflow Patterns
  Session resumption, model state verification, diagnosing user-reported issues
